description: Nightly usage signals per tenant and day (Zurich): ungenutzt (registry feature without use for 30 days), reibung (per route: rage clicks, error toasts, abandoned forms, quick back navigation), zeit (minutes per area), von_hand (per workflow node: share of stage moves done by hand in Pipedrive vs. by signal/agent/CallPilot; area 'uebergaben' = share of delegation answers that were a plain 'yes'). Aggregates only, no persons. Default: last 7 days. Admins, planners and agents. Read-only.
